verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official, managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp that lets MCP clients and AI assistants connect to SumUp APIs. Through it, an agent can query the merchant profile, review transactions, create checkouts and process payments via Cloud API, and a probe confirms the MCP server docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually connecting, and documented details of MCP client setup and authentication.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: SumUp runs a managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments using Cloud API.
Use the SumUp MCP server to connect MCP-compatible clients and AI assistants to SumUp APIs and documentation tools.
Query your merchant profile and review transactions.
Create checkouts and inspect their status.
